blocks.text: 21 November 2022
Juror off sick
Monday, 21 November 2022
(Delay in proceedings)
(Inaudible -- no audio feed from court)
(In the absence of the jury)
Housekeeping

-- juror is seeking medical attention but it will not be until late this afternoon that they can have a telephone appointment. I'm endeavouring to bypass the formalities of the process to see if that situation cannot be improved upon, but in any event it is clearly not going to be possible to sit today, unfortunately, on this case.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: I'm hoping that we may be in a position to proceed tomorrow, but we simply won't know, I don't think, until tomorrow morning. So I don't see there's anything else that can be done at this stage.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: No. Well, we'll use the time to try to at least answer the jury's question and we'll send the answer to my learned friend for his medical advisers to consider the proposed answer at least.
blocks.speaker: MR JOHNSON

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: We think there is a relatively straightforward answer.
blocks.speaker: MR JOHNSON

blocks.text: All right. Other matters can be dealt with. I know that the time will be used to assist with the progress of the case generally.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: Yes. We are grateful for that and we most certainly can use the time with other matters.
blocks.speaker: MR MYERS

blocks.text: So far as Ms Letby is concerned, we obviously will speak to her after this hearing today and use the time for that.
blocks.speaker: MR MYERS

blocks.text: As for tomorrow, we shall wait to hear what comes from the court and if it appears that a hearing is not going to take place, if that's where we get to, then of course we shall notify the
blocks.speaker: MR MYERS

blocks.text: prison or the court will to make sure Ms Letby isn't produced and we shall take instructions as to her position with regard to tomorrow, just to deal with the issues that we raised last time when we were in this position.
blocks.speaker: MR MYERS

blocks.text: Exactly. The difficulty is the appointment presently not being until 4 o'clock this afternoon.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: It's very unhelpful.
blocks.speaker: MR MYERS

blocks.text: It is particularly unhelpful. The situation is the situation.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: MR MYERS

blocks.text: But as I say, I'm going to see if, given the consequences of not having a quicker appointment generally, which I needn't articulate, everyone will understand what they are, I'm just going to see if I can do that. I wouldn't, of course, ordinarily dream of doing it, but this is an unusual, if not unique, relatively unique, situation.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: It is and we're grateful for that, my Lord. We wait to see what comes of it if anything does.
blocks.speaker: MR MYERS

blocks.text: Thank you.
blocks.speaker: MR MYERS

blocks.text: Thank you very much.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: (In the presence of the jury)
Good morning, members of the jury.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: You will realise that you are one short in number.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: Unfortunately, that particular juror is not fit to be at court today. As you know, the consequence of one of you not being available to give evidence is that we simply cannot proceed. I made this plain to you at the very outset of the case and so we cannot proceed today.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: Whether we are going to be able to proceed tomorrow, I don't know. I'm doing my best to expedite matters, but I can't work miracles, so to speak.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: So I'm very sorry. That is it for today. As far as tomorrow is concerned, you have the contact details for the jury officer. Any news that can be imparted to you will be imparted to you. Should it be the case that it is known this afternoon -- it will be late this afternoon -- that we cannot proceed tomorrow, then
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: there will be no need for you to come in tomorrow. But I just don't know the answer to that at the moment. I'm very sorry.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: So that's it for today. Work on the basis that we will be proceeding, I hope, at 10.30 tomorrow morning, and if not, you'll be informed. All right?
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: And of course remember your responsibilities as jurors in this case: no communication by any means with anyone else or even with each other now because you are only 11, and no research about anyone or anything to do with this case. Thank you very much.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: (In the absence of the jury)

As far as the defendant is concerned, you've heard Mr Myers saying he will come down and see her. So please don't remove her from the building until he has completed speaking to her this morning. Thank you very much indeed. I'm grateful to you.
Nothing else, Mr Johnson?
No, thank you, my Lord.
blocks.speaker: MR JOHNSON

blocks.text: Mr Myers?
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: My Lord, no thank you.
blocks.speaker: MR MYERS

blocks.text: Thank you both very much.
blocks.speaker: MR JUSTICE GOSS

blocks.text: (The court adjourned until 10.30 am on Tuesday, 22 November 2022)
